popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer makes Polypoetes son of Peirithous leader of the Lapith contingent — forty ships from Argissa and the Thessalian towns, a fighter at the ships and in the games for Patroclus.

popCulture.title: Polypoetes
popCulture.description: Son of Peirithous and Hippodamia — Lapith captain at Troy, carefully distinct from other namesakes including a son of Apollo.

popCulture.title: Pirithous
popCulture.description: Polypoetes' father — the Lapith king of the Centauromachy whose son inherits the Thessalian command at Troy.

popCulture.title: Catalogue of Ships
popCulture.description: Polypoetes and Leonteus together marshal the Lapith forty ships — the Centauromachy's heirs in the Achaean muster.
